WITH fee_groups AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS overall_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT fg.avg_rebtotal, fg.avg_net_fee_rate, o.overall_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fee_groups AS fg
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE fg.avg_net_fee_rate > o.overall_avg_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_total_rebate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - overall_avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM above_overall;
